sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. Considering the submission as advanced by learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant/convict, it appears before admitting this matter for hearing as to obtain certain clarification on the point of sentence from the learned trial court.

3. In this context, it would be apposite to reproduce the sentence part of the judgment, which runs as under:
"Rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than 10 years and also to pay a fine of Rs. 30,000/- (Thirty Thousand) for offence punishable under section 6 of the POCSO Act and in default of Patna High Court CR.
APP (SJ) No.5254 of 2024(2) dt.09-01-2025 payment of fine, further simple imprisonment of 6 (six)
. Period already undergone by the convict in custody shall be set off from period of his imprisonment.

No separate sentence is passed for the offence punishable under section 376(1) of the I.P.C. because as per section 42 of the POCSO Act, the punishment prescribed for offence under section 6 of the POCSO Act is greater in degree than section 376(1) of IPC."

sentences.text: It transpires that language of sentence is not clear about the fixed term of the sentence above than 10 (ten) years or whether it was rigorous imprisonment for 10 (ten) years only.
5. Learned trial court is directed to clarify the aforesaid aspects positively within two weeks from receipt of a copy of this order.
6. Re-notify this matter on 27.01.2025, position be retained.
